entries.name: Massey University Pet Emergency Centre (Te Pokapu Ohotata)
entries.address: Massey University Veterinary Teaching Hospital, University Avenue, Palmerston North 4474
entries.duty: Open 24 hours from Monday 8am to Saturday 8am. Weekend emergency care (Saturday 8am to Monday 8am) is for Community Practice clients only; other weekend callers are directed to Totally Vets Fielding, +64 6 324 0812. Consultation fee on arrival; 50% deposit if the pet is hospitalised.
entries.note: 24 h claim is weekday-only for the general public; set true because the page says 'Open 24 hours' Mon-Sat. Number 0800 738 363 (0800 PetEmergency) also on vethospital.massey.ac.nz.

entries.name: VSA Sylvia Park - Animal Emergency
entries.address: 1 Te Apunga Place, Mt Wellington (Sylvia Park), Auckland 1060
entries.duty: Accident and emergency vets 24 hours a day. Walk-ins are taken; calling ahead is advised.
entries.note: Home page: 'Emergency vets at VSA Sylvia Park and VSA Auckland West, 24 hours a day', emergency line 09 849 2121. Sylvia Park page gives the address and main line 09 320 5645 and says 'available 24/7 to take emergency consults, walk-ins'.

entries.name: VSA Auckland West - Animal Emergency
entries.duty: Accident and emergency vets 24 hours a day.
entries.note: Home page gives 1/133 Central Park Drive and main line 09 320 5645; another practice page prints 1/33 Central Park Drive (typo likely). VSA Mt Albert closed and moved here (vsahospital ?p=2639). Neighbouring page ?p=360 says 'open 24 hours, 7 days a week, 365 days a year'.

entries.name: ARC After Hours (North Shore)
entries.duty: After-hours emergency clinic. Call before you go.
entries.note: Listed on another practice's contact page; hours not stated and clinic's own site not reachable via the fetch tool, so 24 h not claimed.

entries.name: ARC After Hours (Central Auckland)
entries.duty: After-hours emergency clinic. Call before you go.
entries.note: Same source and caveats as ARC After Hours (North Shore).

entries.name: Manukau After Hours Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: After-hours emergency clinic, not open 24 hours: weekdays from 6pm to 8am; weekends from midday Saturday to 8am Monday.
entries.note: Phone and address from theskinvet contact page; hours from Vet Times employer profile page (opened), not the clinic's own site.

entries.name: The Referral Centre (24/7 emergency and critical care)
entries.duty: Specialist referral and emergency hospital. Contact page lists business hours Mon-Fri 8am-6pm; call to ask about emergency care.
entries.note: Independent check: own site (thereferralcentre.co.nz) confirms phone 0800 83 83 97 and 574 Anglesea Street, Hamilton, but does not state 24/7; only the 2019 NZ Herald article did, so downgraded. Site links separate 'Emergency Hamilton' pages with no hours seen.

entries.name: Wellington After Hours Vet Clinic
entries.duty: Regional after-hours emergency clinic for Wellington. Call first so staff expect you.
entries.note: Clinic's own site could not be fetched (not in provenance set). Name/number confirmed on Crofton Downs Veterinary Clinic's page and on plimmerton.nz; opening hours not found.

entries.name: Crofton Downs Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 7:30am-7pm, Sat 9am-4pm, closed Sundays and public holidays. After hours, emergencies go to Wellington After Hours Vet Clinic, +64 4 473 7545.

entries.name: Christchurch Afterhours Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: After-hours emergency clinic: Mon-Thu 7pm-8am; Fri 7pm to Mon 8am; open all public holidays. Not open 24 hours on weekdays.
entries.note: Independent check: own site (branded After Hours Vets / After Hours Veterinary Centre) confirms phone and address and gives set hours, no 24 h claim; the '24-hour' wording came from Hornby Veterinary Centre's page, so downgraded.

entries.name: Hornby Veterinary Centre
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-7pm, Sat 8am-2pm, closed Sunday. After hours, call Christchurch Afterhours Veterinary Clinic, +64 3 366 1052.

entries.name: Rangiora Vet Centre
entries.duty: See the clinic's After Hours page for out-of-hours arrangements.
entries.note: Hours and after-hours number not on the opened page.

entries.name: VetSouth Invercargill
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 8am-5:30pm; Wed 8am-8pm; Sat 9am-1pm. 24-hour on-call service for small animals: call the clinic number.
entries.note: Page says '24hr on call service for small animals' (on-call, not a staffed emergency hospital), so emergency_24h left false.

entries.name: Remarkable Vet Queenstown (SPCA Queenstown Vet Partnership)
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, Sat 9am-1pm, closed Sunday; hours may differ on public holidays. Call for advice in an emergency.
entries.note: No after-hours emergency arrangement stated on the page.

entries.name: Petfirst Queenstown
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm, closed Sunday. After-hours emergencies: see the clinic locator on the website.
entries.note: No phone on the opened page.

entries.name: NZ Animal Poisons Helpline
entries.duty: Poisons advice line for New Zealand pet owners and vet clinics. Charges apply. For a poisoned animal also call your vet; the human National Poisons Centre refers animal cases here.
entries.note: Hours not stated on the page, so 24 h not claimed. Australian helpline page (animalpoisons.com.au/news/nz-helpline-coming-soon) is a 'coming soon' notice with no number.

notes: Partial run. Own-site coverage was limited because the fetch tool only opens URLs already surfaced by search. Left unreachable/unverified: animalemergency.co.nz (VSA Animal Emergency own site, redirect target); wellingtonafterhoursvetclinic.co.nz; Waikato After Hours Veterinary Hospital, 576 Anglesea Street, Hamilton (neighbourly page: Mon-Thu 6pm-8am, Fri 6pm-Mon 8am, 'open 24 hours on weekends and public holidays', email only, no phone/own site); Dunedin Emergency Vet Clinic (ODT articles only, no phone/address; small animals, 7 days from May); Hawke's Bay Urgent Care and After Hours Veterinary Clinic, Grays Rd, Hastings (NZ Herald only, no phone; 6pm-8am); North Shore Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care (+64 9 443 5640 per community directory only); Tauranga (Bayfair Vets, Tauranga Vets etc. only on a community directory; Sunlive 2017 says every Tauranga vet has after-hours provision); Rotorua, Taupo, Nelson, Napier, Whangarei, Christchurch afterhours own site. Marshall & Pringle PETMED clinic +64 3 327 8455 (town not stated). pets-org-nz.pages.dev is a community directory and was used only as a lead.
